shtender.prompt: A wooden yeshiva lectern (shtender) with an open Gemara on it, seen from the front, as wide as it is tall.

laptop.prompt: An open silver laptop seen from the front, its screen glowing blue with lines of code.

gemara.prompt: A big open Gemara (Talmud volume), seen from the front, held up open.

zvi-sign.prompt: Tzvi Kaplan from the reference (navy cap reading "ברית המשרתים", thin black sunglasses, linen blazer), upper body, arrogant, swinging a big protest sign on a stick like a hammer. The sign reads "תתגייס!" in big bold black Hebrew letters, spelled exactly like that.

workers.prompt: The two Haredi restaurant workers from the reference (the older plump one with the grey beard and the young thin one with the short red beard, white aprons), seen from the side, running fast towards the LEFT together, carrying one big steaming cholent pot between them. Full bodies, feet visible.

puddle.prompt: A blue rain puddle on the ground, flat, seen from a low side angle.

boxes.prompt: A small stack of two cardboard boxes, side view.

stroller.prompt: An empty dark-blue baby stroller, side view.

door.prompt: The entrance of an old Bnei Brak apartment building with a wooden door and a mezuzah, and Yosef from the reference (black kippa, round glasses, black beard, white shirt) standing in the open doorway waving happily.

yeshiva.prompt: Inside a big bright beit midrash (yeshiva study hall): tall bookshelves full of holy books along the back wall, big windows, warm light, a wooden floor. The lower two thirds of the picture is open floor with nothing on it.

street.prompt: Rabbi Akiva street in Bnei Brak on a Friday afternoon, seen from the side like a side-scrolling game: a row of old apartment buildings and small shops with no readable signs, a sidewalk running along the whole bottom of the picture, a soft orange sky before Shabbat.

whack-bg.prompt: A whack-a-mole game board. The front and middle of the picture: the wooden floor of a beit midrash, completely empty (the game puts the lecterns there). The back: the wall opens with huge windows onto a glowing MODERN hi-tech city - shiny glass towers, big screens, a train, drones - clearly the modern working world outside, calling. Bright daylight.

shtender2.prompt: A big wooden yeshiva shtender (lectern) built like a closed wooden box, seen from the front and a little above, an open Gemara lying on its slanted top.
